messages:
maria: kicking off staged rollout: v2.4.1-rc3 -> 12% EU (canary c-9123). change window until 22:00 UTC. release notes: https://redwood.internal/rn/v2.4.1-rc3 :eyes:
deploybot: [canary=c-9123] starting traffic shift: target=12% region=eu-west-1 requests=900rpm
status: in_progress metrics_url=https://telemetry/redwood/c-9123
metrics snapshot: {"error_rate": 0.005, "p95_latency_ms": 210}

noah: seeing a 502/503 spike in eu-west-1, p95 up to 420ms. errors concentrated on inference-*-pod. can we hold?
alex: agree, pause until SRE confirms. @sre-oncall please check the canary group.
sre-oncall: looking now. quick grep shows increased 5xxs hitting nodes with kv-cache evictions. pulling recent pod logs.
lucy: note: infra rolled a cache node update ~10m ago in eu-west-1. I filed infra ticket INF-422. could be related. recommend pause and pin back to v2.4.0 until we confirm.
maria: quick vote: pause+pin to v2.4.0 for EU while infra investigates. react :+1: to pause, :-1: to continue. deploybot, please hold if majority.
deploybot: ack. pausing canary c-9123 at 12%. executing rollback-pin: 
```
> rollback-pin --canary c-9123 --region eu-west-1 --target v2.4.0 --reason "kv-cache evictions spike"
Result: pinned traffic back to v2.4.0 for eu-west-1
Rollback job id: rb-3377
```
noah: :+1: thanks — monitoring the error rate now.
sre-oncall: watching. if error_rate doesn't fall below 0.001 (0.1%) within 10m we'll escalate and open a postmortem.
alex: once cache nodes are green, can we try a micro-canary 3% warmup and watch tail latency?
lucy: cache node redeploy scheduled in ~3m. I'll post updates.
maria: updated the release notes + changelog to note the pin and reason: https://redwood.internal/rn/v2.4.1-rc3#rollback-note
